attr.title: Hot Wheels Stunt Track Driver
attr.desc: Race toy cars through loops and jumps built across a house and backyard. The original 1998 Windows game running through box64 and Wine.
attr.inst: Copy the contents of the CD's setup/hot98 folder (stunt.exe, data, menudata, saves) into ports/hwstd/gamedata/, or put your CD image (.iso) in ports/hwstd/ and the port extracts it. The first launch prepares Wine and takes a few minutes.
